segments.name: Pipeline Research and Development
segments.evidence: The Group contains one reportable operating segment, Pipeline Research and Development ('Pipeline R&D').

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from customers for services supplied under research and development collaboration agreements, recognised over the contract term; no revenue was earned in 2024 or 2025.
revenueModel.evidence: All revenue came from the sale of services in 2023. It is derived entirely from the Group's R&D collaboration agreements.

changes.text: In 2023 the company changed its name to Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC and repositioned itself as a therapeutics rather than drug delivery company.
changes.evidence: In early 2023, we decided to re-position the Company as therapeutics (as opposed to drug delivery) company and we began looking for additional assets.
